description: Source code for QuicProxyClientSocket class implementing a network socket for QUIC proxy connections, including connection management, request handling, and response processing.

classes.name: QuicProxyClientSocket
classes.description: A network socket class for managing QUIC proxy connections, handling connection setup, data transmission, and response processing.

methods.name: QuicProxyClientSocket
methods.description: Constructor initializing the socket with stream, session, proxy info, user agent, endpoint, logging, auth controller, and delegate.

methods.name: ~QuicProxyClientSocket
methods.description: Destructor that disconnects the socket and ends logging event.

methods.name: GetConnectResponseInfo
methods.description: Returns the HTTP response info for the connection.

methods.name: GetAuthController
methods.description: Returns the authentication controller used by the socket.

methods.name: RestartWithAuth
methods.description: Restarts the connection with authentication callback, not reusable for proxy auth.

methods.name: SetStreamPriority
methods.description: Sets the priority of the stream; currently a no-op.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Initiates connection, sending CONNECT request and handling response.

methods.name: Disconnect
methods.description: Closes the connection and resets internal state.

methods.name: IsConnectedAndIdle
methods.description: Checks if socket is connected and has no data to read.

methods.name: WasEverUsed
methods.description: Indicates if the session was used.

methods.name: WasAlpnNegotiated
methods.description: Indicates if ALPN was negotiated; always false here.

methods.name: GetNegotiatedProtocol
methods.description: Returns the negotiated protocol; unknown here.

methods.name: ApplySocketTag
methods.description: Applies socket tag; only supports default tag.

methods.name: OnIOComplete
methods.description: Handles I/O completion and continues the loop.

methods.name: DoReadReplyComplete
methods.description: Processes reply headers and determines success.

methods.name: ProcessResponseHeaders
methods.description: Converts headers to HttpResponseInfo and checks validity.
